description: This source file manages the setup and execution of Vitest-based tests with environment and lock handling, including spawning test processes, managing test specifications, and cleanup.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures that the lock release function is called only once to prevent multiple releases.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Removes the include file path if it exists, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Runs a specified Vitest test spec, including setting up include files and handling process exit and errors.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates a default test run specification based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that parses arguments, creates test specs, runs them, and handles process termination and cleanup.
